## **Where is area code 236?**

Area code 236 serves all of British Columbia, Canada. It is an overlay for area code 604 and area code 250 and serves the combined area.

## **What time zone is area code 236?**

The 236 area code is located in the Pacific timezone. The Pacific time zone is also known as America/Los\_Angeles. As of the last time this page was loaded.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 236 was put into service on June 1, 2013 and was the 368th area code in service. It was one of 8 area codes introduced in 2013. It was the 4th area code in the province of British Columbia. British Columbia currently has 5 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 604 area code as the numbers in 604 were being exhausted.

**New/recent overlays:** Though future plans may change, area code 257 has been proposed as a possible overlay for area code 236. The new overlay is expected to go in service on May 24, 2025.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 236 is an overlay area code for area code 604.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 236 include ADM, ADN, ADO, AEM, AEN, AEO, AFM, AFN, AFO, BDM, BDN, BDO, BEM, BEN, BEO, BFM, BFN, BFO, CDM, CDN, CDO, CEM, CEN, CEO, CFM, CFN, and CFO. ## **Where is area code 234?**

Area code 234 serves northeastern Ohio except the area along Lake Erie. It includes the cities of Akron, Canton, and Youngstown. It is an overlay for area code 330 and serves the same area.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 234 was put into service on October 30, 2000 and was the 285th area code in service. It was one of 14 area codes introduced in 2000. It was the 9th area code in the state of Ohio. Ohio currently has 15 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 330 area code as the numbers in 330 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 234 is an overlay area code for area code 330.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 234 include ADG, ADH, ADI, AEG, AEH, AEI, AFG, AFH, AFI, BDG, BDH, BDI, BEG, BEH, BEI, BFG, BFH, BFI, CDG, CDH, CDI, CEG, CEH, CEI, CFG, CFH, and CFI. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 228 was put into service on September 15, 1997 and was the 215th area code in service. It was one of 43 area codes introduced in 1997. It was the 2nd area code in the state of Mississippi. Mississippi currently has 4 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 601 area code as the numbers in 601 were being exhausted.

**7 digit dialing:** Before area code overlays were made common in the 1990s, a local phone number could be dialed without dialing the area code – just dialing the last 7 digits of the phone number. Without overlays, it was clear that a 7 digit number should be routed to the local area code. However, with overlays, multiple area codes can serve a single area which makes the area code for a 7 digit number ambiguous. Of the 467 area codes currently active, area code 228 is one of fewer than 71 that still allow 7 digit dialing for local calls. At minimum, to support 7 digit dialing, an area code must not have an overlay and must not allocate numbers of the form 988-XXXX to avoid ambiguity with the 988 suicide prevention lifeline implemented in 2022-2023.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 227 was put into service on June 14, 2023 and was the 455th area code in service. It was one of 16 area codes introduced in 2023. It was the 6th area code in the state of Maryland. Maryland currently has 6 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 301 area code as the numbers in 301 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 227 is an overlay area code for area code 301.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 227 include AAP, AAQ, AAR, AAS, ABP, ABQ, ABR, ABS, ACP, ACQ, ACR, ACS, BAP, BAQ, BAR, BAS, BBP, BBQ, BBR, BBS, BCP, BCQ, BCR, BCS, CAP, CAQ, CAR, CAS, CBP, CBQ, CBR, CBS, CCP, CCQ, CCR, and CCS. ## **Where is area code 226?**

Area code 226 serves southwestern Ontario, Canada including London, ON. It is an overlay for area code 519 and serves the same area.

## **What time zone is area code 226?**

The 226 area code is located in the Eastern timezone. The Eastern time zone is also known as America/New\_York. As of the last time this page was loaded.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 226 was put into service on October 21, 2006 and was the 330th area code in service. It was one of 4 area codes introduced in 2006. In 2016, area code 548 was created from 226. It was the 9th area code in the province of Ontario. Ontario currently has 18 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 519 area code as the numbers in 519 were being exhausted.

**New/recent overlays:** Area code 382 was recently added as on overaly to the 226 area code on June 17, 2023.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 226 is an overlay area code for area code 519.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 226 include AAM, AAN, AAO, ABM, ABN, ABO, ACM, ACN, ACO, BAM, BAN, BAO, BBM, BBN, BBO, BCM, BCN, BCO, CAM, CAN, CAO, CBM, CBN, CBO, CCM, CCN, and CCO. Let us know if one of these mnemonics fits area code 226 so we can feature it.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 224 was put into service on January 5, 2002 and was the 313th area code in service. It was one of 9 area codes introduced in 2002. It was the 10th area code in the state of Illinois. Illinois currently has 17 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 847 area code as the numbers in 847 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 224 is an overlay area code for area code 847.

## **History**

**Creation:**Area code 223 was put into service on September 26, 2017 and was the 400th area code in service. It was one of 9 area codes introduced in 2017. It was the 12th area code in the state of Pennsylvania. Pennsylvania currently has 15 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 717 area code as the numbers in 717 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 223 is an overlay area code for area code 717.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. ## Where is area code 220?

Area code 220 is located in southeastern Ohio and covers Newark, Lancaster, and Marion. It is an overlay for area code 740 and serves the same area

## What time zone is area code 220?

The 220 area code is located in the Eastern timezone. The Eastern time zone is also known as America/New\_York. As of the last time this page was loaded.

## History

**Creation:** Area code 220 was put into service on April 22, 2015 and was the 383rd area code in service. It was one of 7 area codes introduced in 2015. It was the 11th area code in the state of Ohio. Ohio currently has 15 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 740 area code as the numbers in 740 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 220 is an overlay area code for area code 740.

## History

**Creation:** Area code 219 was put into service in 1948 and was the 87th area code in service and the first area code created after the originaly 86 area codes were put in place. It was the only area code introduced in 1948. 219 was split in 2002 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 260, and again in 2002 to create area code 574. It was the 3rd area code in the state of Indiana. Indiana currently has 8 area codes.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 219 area code is 1 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 219 never served the entire state of Indiana.

**Pulses:** Because area code 219 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 219 area code requires 2 + 1 + 9 = 12 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 219 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 219 was prioritized more than other area codes created about the same time. The 467 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3.

## History

**Creation:** Area code 216 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served northeastern Ohio including Cleveland. 216 was split in 1996 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 330, and again in 1997 to create area code 440. It was the 1st area code in the state of Ohio. Ohio currently has 15 area codes.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 216 area code is 1 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 216 never served the entire state of Ohio.

**Pulses:** Because area code 216 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 216 area code requires 2 + 1 + 6 = 9 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 216 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 216 was prioritized more than other area codes created about the same time. The 467 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3. Only 22 area codes require fewer pulses than area code 216.

**7 digit dialing:** Before area code overlays were made common in the 1990s, a local phone number could be dialed without dialing the area code – just dialing the last 7 digits of the phone number. Without overlays, it was clear that a 7 digit number should be routed to the local area code. However, with overlays, multiple area codes can serve a single area which makes the area code for a 7 digit number ambiguous. Of the 467 area codes currently active, area code 216 is one of fewer than 71 that still allow 7 digit dialing for local calls. At minimum, to support 7 digit dialing, an area code must not have an overlay and must not allocate numbers of the form 988-XXXX to avoid ambiguity with the 988 suicide prevention lifeline implemented in 2022-2023.

## Where is area code 215?

Area code 215 serves Philadelphia, PA and the surrounding areas. It has 2 overlays (267 and 445) that serve the same area.

## What time zone is area code 215?

The 215 area code is located in the Eastern timezone. The Eastern time zone is also known as America/New\_York. As of the last time this page was loaded.

## History

**Creation:** Area code 215 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served southeastern Pennsylvania including Philadelphia. In 1999, area code 267 was created and is currently an overlay to 215. It was the 1st area code in the state of Pennsylvania. Pennsylvania currently has 15 area codes.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 215 area code is 1 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 215 never served the entire state of Pennsylvania.

**Pulses:** Because area code 215 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 215 area code requires 2 + 1 + 5 = 8 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 215 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 215 was prioritized more than other area codes created about the same time. The 467 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3. Only 10 area codes require fewer pulses (212, 213, 312, 231, 321, 214, 313, 412, 331, and 223) than area code 215.

## History

**Creation:** Area code 213 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served southern California including Los Angeles. 213 was split in 1998 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 323. It was the 1st area code in the state of California. California currently has 38 area codes.

**New/recent overlays:** Though future plans may change, area code 738 has been proposed as a possible overlay for area code 213. The new overlay is expected to go in service on November 1, 2024.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 213 area code is 1 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 213 never served the entire state of California.

**Pulses:** Because area code 213 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 213 area code requires 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 213 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 213 was prioritized more than other area codes created about the same time. The 467 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3. Only 1 area code requires fewer pulses (212) than area code 213.

Area code 212 serves Manhattan in New York City, NY. It overlaps coverage areas with area codes 332, 646, and 917.

## History

**Creation:** Area code 212 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served New York City. In 1999, area code 646 was created and is currently an overlay to 212. In 2017, area code 332 was created and is currently an overlay to 212. It was the 1st area code in the state of New York. New York currently has 22 area codes.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 212 area code is 1 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 212 never served the entire state of New York.

**Pulses:** Because area code 212 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 212 area code requires 2 + 1 + 2 = 5 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 212 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 212 was prioritized more than other area codes created about the same time. The 467 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3. No active area codes require fewer pulses that area code 212.

## History

**Creation:** Area code 210 was put into service on November 1, 1992 and was the 142nd area code in service. It was one of 4 area codes introduced in 1992. 210 was split in 1997 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 830, and again in 1997 to create area code 956. In 2017, area code 726 was created and is currently an overlay to 210. It was the 9th area code in the state of Texas. Texas currently has 28 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 512 area code as the numbers in 512 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 210 is an overlay area code for area code 512.

## Where is area code 209?

Area code 209 is located in California and covers Stockton, Modesto, Tracy, Merced, and Turlock. It has a single overlay (350) that serves the same area.

## What time zone is area code 209?

The 209 area code is located in the Pacific timezone. The Pacific time zone is also known as America/Los\_Angeles. As of the last time this page was loaded.

## History

**Creation:** Area code 209 was put into service in 1958 and was the 114th area code in service. It was one of 2 area codes introduced in 1958. 209 was split in 1998 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 559. In 2022, area code 350 was created and is currently an overlay to 209. It was the 6th area code in the state of California. California currently has 38 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 415 area code as the numbers in 415 were being exhausted.

**New/recent overlays:**Area code 350 was recently added as on overaly to the 209 area code on November 28, 2022.

**Pulses:** Because area code 209 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 209 area code requires 2 + 10 + 9 = 21 pulses to dial. The 26 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 209 averaged 21.8 pulses indicating 209 was prioritized more than other area codes created about the same time. The 467 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3.

## History

**Creation:** Area code 207 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served the entire state of Maine. It is currently the only area code in the state of Maine. Maine is one of only 11 states that still have only a single area code.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 207 area code is 0 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 207 originally served the entire state of Maine. It is one of only 15 of the original 86 area codes that are still used for an entire state.

**Pulses:** Because area code 207 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 207 area code requires 2 + 10 + 7 = 19 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 207 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 207 was prioritized less than other area codes created about the same time. The 467 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3.

**7 digit dialing:** Before area code overlays were made common in the 1990s, a local phone number could be dialed without dialing the area code – just dialing the last 7 digits of the phone number. Without overlays, it was clear that a 7 digit number should be routed to the local area code. However, with overlays, multiple area codes can serve a single area which makes the area code for a 7 digit number ambiguous. Of the 467 area codes currently active, area code 207 is one of fewer than 71 that still allow 7 digit dialing for local calls. At minimum, to support 7 digit dialing, an area code must not have an overlay and must not allocate numbers of the form 988-XXXX to avoid ambiguity with the 988 suicide prevention lifeline implemented in 2022-2023.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 989 was put into service on April 7, 2001 and was the 293rd area code in service. It was one of 26 area codes introduced in 2001. It was the 9th area code in the state of Michigan. Michigan currently has 12 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 517 area code as the numbers in 517 were being exhausted.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 986 was put into service on September 5, 2017 and was the 397th area code in service. It was one of 9 area codes introduced in 2017. It was the 2nd area code in the state of Idaho. Idaho currently has 2 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 208 area code as the numbers in 208 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 986 is an overlay area code for area code 208.

**Mnemonics:**Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 986 include WTM, WTN, WTO, WUM, WUN, WUO, WVM, WVN, WVO, XTM, XTN, XTO, XUM, XUN, XUO, XVM, XVN, XVO, YTM, YTN, YTO, YUM, YUN, YUO, YVM, YVN, YVO, ZTM, ZTN, ZTO, ZUM, ZUN, ZUO, ZVM, ZVN, and ZVO. ## **What time zone is area code 984 ?**

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 984 was put into service on April 30, 2012 and was the 361st area code in service. It was one of 6 area codes introduced in 2012. It was the 8th area code in the state of North Carolina. North Carolina currently has 10 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 919 area code as the numbers in 919 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 984 is an overlay area code for area code 919.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 984 include WTG, WTH, WTI, WUG, WUH, WUI, WVG, WVH, WVI, XTG, XTH, XTI, XUG, XUH, XUI, XVG, XVH, XVI, YTG, YTH, YTI, YUG, YUH, YUI, YVG, YVH, YVI, ZTG, ZTH, ZTI, ZUG, ZUH, ZUI, ZVG, ZVH, and ZVI. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 980 was put into service on April 1, 2001 and was the 292nd area code in service. It was one of 26 area codes introduced in 2001. It was the 7th area code in the state of North Carolina. North Carolina currently has 10 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 704 area code as the numbers in 704 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 980 is an overlay area code for area code 704.

## **Where is area code 983?**

Area code 983 is located in central Colorado and covers Denver, Aurora, Lakewood, Thornton, Arvada, Westminster, and Centennial. It is an overlay for area code 303 and serves the same area.

## **What time zone is area code 983?**

The 983 area code is located in the Mountain timezone. The Mountain time zone is also known as America/Denver. As of the last time this page was loaded.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 983 was put into service on June 17, 2022 and was the 435th area code in service. It was one of 19 area codes introduced in 2022. It was the 5th area code in the state of Colorado. Colorado currently has 5 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 303 area code as the numbers in 303 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 983 is an overlay area code for area code 303.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 983 include WTD, WTE, WTF, WUD, WUE, WUF, WVD, WVE, WVF, XTD, XTE, XTF, XUD, XUE, XUF, XVD, XVE, XVF, YTD, YTE, YTF, YUD, YUE, YUF, YVD, YVE, YVF, ZTD, ZTE, ZTF, ZUD, ZUE, ZUF, ZVD, ZVE, and ZVF. ## **Where is area code 971?**

Area code 971 is located in northwestern Oregon and covers Portland, Salem, Gresham, Hillsboro, and Beaverton. It is an overlay for area code 503 and serves the same area.

## **What time zone is area code 971?**

The 971 area code is located in the Pacific timezone. The Pacific time zone is also known as America/Los\_Angeles. As of the last time this page was loaded.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 971 was put into service on October 1, 2000 and was the 283rd area code in service. It was one of 14 area codes introduced in 2000. It was the 3rd area code in the state of Oregon. Oregon currently has 4 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 503 area code as the numbers in 503 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 971 is an overlay area code for area code 503.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 970 was put into service on April 2, 1995 and was the 153rd area code in service. It was one of 14 area codes introduced in 1995. It was the 3rd area code in the state of Colorado. Colorado currently has 5 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 303 area code as the numbers in 303 were being exhausted.

**New/recent overlays:** Though future plans may change, area code 748 has been proposed as a possible overlay for area code 970. The new overlay is expected to go in service on July 7, 2025.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. When the 970 area code was created in 1995, it was the 4th area code without 0 or 1 as the middle digit.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 970 is an overlay area code for area code 303.

## **Where is area code 959?**

Area code 959 is located in northeastern Connecticut and covers Hartford, New Britain, West Hartford, Bristol, and East Hartford. It is an overlay for area code 860 and serves the same area.

## **What time zone is area code 959?**

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 959 was put into service on August 30, 2014 and was the 377th area code in service. It was one of 6 area codes introduced in 2014. It was the 4th area code in the state of Connecticut. Connecticut currently has 4 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 860 area code as the numbers in 860 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 959 is an overlay area code for area code 860.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 959 include WJW, WJX, WJY, WJZ, WKW, WKX, WKY, WKZ, WLW, WLX, WLY, WLZ, XJW, XJX, XJY, XJZ, XKW, XKX, XKY, XKZ, XLW, XLX, XLY, XLZ, YJW, YJX, YJY, YJZ, YKW, YKX, YKY, YKZ, YLW, YLX, YLY, YLZ, ZJW, ZJX, ZJY, ZJZ, ZKW, ZKX, ZKY, ZKZ, ZLW, ZLX, ZLY, and ZLZ. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 952 was put into service on February 27, 2000 and was the 274th area code in service. It was one of 14 area codes introduced in 2000. It was the 6th area code in the state of Minnesota. Minnesota currently has 8 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 612 area code as the numbers in 612 were being exhausted.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. When the 952 area code was created in 2000, it was the 125th area code without 0 or 1 as the middle digit.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 943 was put into service on March 15, 2022 and was the 430th area code in service. It was one of 19 area codes introduced in 2022. It was the 10th area code in the state of Georgia. Georgia currently has 10 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 470 area code as the numbers in 470 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 943 is an overlay area code for area code 470.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 937 was put into service on September 28, 1996 and was the 179th area code in service. It was one of 21 area codes introduced in 1996. In 2020, area code 326 was created and is currently an overlay to 937. It was the 6th area code in the state of Ohio. Ohio currently has 15 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 513 area code as the numbers in 513 were being exhausted.

**New/recent overlays:** Area code 326 was recently added as on overaly to the 937 area code on March 8, 2020.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. When the 937 area code was created in 1996, it was the 30th area code without 0 or 1 as the middle digit.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 937 is an overlay area code for area code 513.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. Area code 938 is located in northeastern Alabama and covers Huntsville, Decatur, and Madison. It is an overlay for area code 256 and serves the same area.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 938 was put into service on July 10, 2010 and was the 349th area code in service. It was one of 8 area codes introduced in 2010. It was the 5th area code in the state of Alabama. Alabama currently has 6 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 256 area code as the numbers in 256 were being exhausted.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. When the 938 area code was created in 2010, it was the 200th area code without 0 or 1 as the middle digit.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 938 is an overlay area code for area code 256.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 938 include WDT, WDU, WDV, WET, WEU, WEV, WFT, WFU, WFV, XDT, XDU, XDV, XET, XEU, XEV, XFT, XFU, XFV, YDT, YDU, YDV, YET, YEU, YEV, YFT, YFU, YFV, ZDT, ZDU, ZDV, ZET, ZEU, ZEV, ZFT, ZFU, and ZFV. Let us know if one of these mnemonics fits area code 938 so we can feature it.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 934 was put into service on July 16, 2016 and was the 390th area code in service. It was one of 7 area codes introduced in 2016. It was the 16th area code in the state of New York. New York currently has 22 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 631 area code as the numbers in 631 were being exhausted.

**Overlay::** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 934 is an overlay area code for area code 631.

**Mnemonics::** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 934 include WDG, WDH, WDI, WEG, WEH, WEI, WFG, WFH, WFI, XDG, XDH, XDI, XEG, XEH, XEI, XFG, XFH, XFI, YDG, YDH, YDI, YEG, YEH, YEI, YFG, YFH, YFI, ZDG, ZDH, ZDI, ZEG, ZEH, ZEI, ZFG, ZFH, and ZFI. **Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. When the 930 area code was created in 2015, it was the 230th area code without 0 or 1 as the middle digit.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 930 is an overlay area code for area code 812.

Area code 929 serves New York City, NY excluding Manhattan excluding Manhattan. It is an overlay for area code 718 and serves the same area.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 929 was put into service on April 16, 2011 and was the 357th area code in service. It was one of 5 area codes introduced in 2011. It was the 15th area code in the state of New York. New York currently has 22 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 347 area code as the numbers in 347 were being exhausted.

**Overlay::** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 929 is an overlay area code for area code 347.

**Mnemonics::** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 929 include WAW, WAX, WAY, WAZ, WBW, WBX, WBY, WBZ, WCW, WCX, WCY, WCZ, XAW, XAX, XAY, XAZ, XBW, XBX, XBY, XBZ, XCW, XCX, XCY, XCZ, YAW, YAX, YAY, YAZ, YBW, YBX, YBY, YBZ, YCW, YCX, YCY, YCZ, ZAW, ZAX, ZAY, ZAZ, ZBW, ZBX, ZBY, ZBZ, ZCW, ZCX, ZCY, and ZCZ. Area code 928 is the area code for most of Arizona except Phoenix and Tucson. It includes the cities of Yuma, Flagstaff, and Lake Havasu City. It is the only area code that serves the area.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 928 was put into service on June 23, 2001 and was the 301st area code in service. It was one of 26 area codes introduced in 2001. It was the 5th area code in the state of Arizona. Arizona currently has 5 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 520 area code as the numbers in 520 were being exhausted.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 928 include WAT, WAU, WAV, WBT, WBU, WBV, WCT, WCU, WCV, XAT, XAU, XAV, XBT, XBU, XBV, XCT, XCU, XCV, YAT, YAU, YAV, YBT, YBU, YBV, YCT, YCU, YCV, ZAT, ZAU, ZAV, ZBT, ZBU, ZBV, ZCT, ZCU, and ZCV. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 920 was put into service on July 26, 1997 and was the 210th area code in service. It was one of 43 area codes introduced in 1997. In 2023, area code 274 was created and is currently an overlay to 920. It was the 4th area code in the state of Wisconsin. Wisconsin currently has 8 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 414 area code as the numbers in 414 were being exhausted.

**New/recent overlays:** Area code 274 was recently added as on overaly to the 920 area code on May 5, 2023.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 920 is an overlay area code for area code 414.

Because the middle digit of the 203 area code is 0 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 203 originally served the entire state of Connecticut. However, it not longer does.

## History

**Creation:** Area code 204 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served the entire state of Manitoba. In 2012, area code 431 was created and is currently an overlay to 204. In 2022, area code 584 was created and is currently an overlay to 204. It was the 1st area code in the province of Manitoba. Manitoba currently has 3 area codes.

**New/recent overlays:** Area code 584 was recently added as on overaly to the 204 area code on October 29, 2022.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire province while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a province. Because the middle digit of the 204 area code is 0 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 204 originally served the entire province of Manitoba. It is one of only 15 of the original 86 area codes that are still used for an entire state.

**Pulses:** Because area code 204 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 204 area code requires 2 + 10 + 4 = 16 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 204 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 204 was prioritized less than other area codes created about the same time. The 467 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3.

## Understanding the 202 Area Code: A Comprehensive Guide

### Introduction

The 202 area code is more than just a series of numbers; it’s a symbol of a vibrant and historically significant region in the United States. Nestled at the heart of Washington, D.C., the 202 area code is synonymous with power, culture, and a rich tapestry of history. But why do area codes matter? They are crucial in the realm of communication, helping us connect with one another across distances, providing identity to regions, and facilitating the smooth operation of businesses and services.

### History of the 202 Area Code

The 202 area code holds the distinction of being one of the original area codes established in 1947 by AT&T and the Bell System. It was part of the North American Numbering Plan (NANP) designed to streamline the growing complexity of telephone systems across the continent. Over the years, as the population and the demand for telephone lines grew, the 202 area code evolved, maintaining its relevance and adapting to technological advancements.

### Geographic Coverage

Primarily, the 202 area code serves Washington, D.C., the epicenter of the United States federal government. Initially, it covered a broader area, but over time, its boundaries have been fine-tuned to cater specifically to the city and its immediate surroundings. Despite its relatively small geographic footprint, the 202 area code is densely packed with significance.

### Cultural and Economic Significance

Washington, D.C., is not just the political heart of the nation but also a cultural and economic hub. The 202 area code is integral to the identity of this city. It connects numerous government agencies, international embassies, and major corporations. The presence of this area code often implies prestige and importance, particularly for businesses and organizations operating within its bounds.

### Demographic Insights

Washington, D.C., boasts a diverse population, reflected in the demographic distribution of the 202 area code. The area is home to a mix of government employees, professionals, students, and a vibrant community of residents from various cultural backgrounds. This diversity enriches the fabric of daily life and contributes to the dynamic nature of the 202 area code region.

### Famous Landmarks and Institutions

Within the 202 area code, you’ll find some of the most iconic landmarks and institutions in the country. This includes the White House, the U.S. Capitol, the Supreme Court, and a plethora of museums and monuments that form the Smithsonian Institution. Educational institutions like Georgetown University and Howard University also fall within this prestigious area code, further emphasizing its significance.

### Impact on Daily Life

For residents and businesses in Washington, D.C., the 202 area code is an everyday part of life. It’s not just about making phone calls; it’s about the identity and connection it provides. Having a 202 number often signifies a direct link to the heart of the nation’s capital, which can be a point of pride and a mark of distinction.

### Technological Evolution

The 202 area code has witnessed significant technological changes over the decades. From the early days of rotary phones to the current era dominated by smartphones and internet communication, the area code has adapted seamlessly. The transition from landlines to mobile phones and the rise of digital communication platforms have all played a role in shaping the current landscape of the 202 area code.

### Area Code 202 in Popular Culture

The 202 area code has made its mark in popular culture, appearing in numerous movies, TV shows, and songs. It often serves as a shorthand for Washington, D.C., invoking images of political drama, historical significance, and cultural richness. Whether it’s in a gripping political thriller or a catchy song lyric, the 202 area code adds a layer of authenticity and recognition.

### Challenges and Issues

Despite its prestige, the 202 area code is not without its challenges. One of the primary issues is number exhaustion, where the demand for new numbers exceeds the available supply. This has led to the introduction of overlays and other solutions to ensure everyone can still get a number. Area code 917 serves all five boroughs of New York City, NY. It is an overlay for area code 212 and area code 718 and serves the combined area.

## **What time zone is area code 917 ?**

The 917 area code is located in the Eastern timezone. The Eastern time zone is also known as America/New\_York. As of the last time this page was loaded.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 917 was put into service on January 1, 1992 and was the 140th area code in service. It was one of 4 area codes introduced in 1992. It was the 9th area code in the state of New York. New York currently has 22 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 212 area code as the numbers in 212 were being exhausted.

**Overlay::** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 917 is an overlay area code for area code 212.

### **Geographic Coverage**

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 914 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served southern New York including Long Island but not including New York City. 914 was split in 2000 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 845. It was the 1st area code in the state of New York. New York currently has 22 area codes.

**Middle digit::** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 914 area code is 1 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 914 never served the entire state of New York.

**Pulses:** Because area code 914 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 914 area code requires 9 + 1 + 4 = 14 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 914 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 914 was prioritized more than other area codes created about the same time. The 469 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3.

**Creation:** Area code 425 was put into service on April 27, 1997 and was the 190th area code in service. It was one of 43 area codes introduced in 1997. It was the 4th area code in the state of Washington. Washington currently has 6 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 206 area code as the numbers in 206 were being exhausted.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. When the 425 area code was created in 1997, it was the 41st area code without 0 or 1 as the middle digit.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 425 include GAJ, GAK, GAL, GBJ, GBK, GBL, GCJ, GCK, GCL, HAJ, HAK, HAL, HBJ, HBK, HBL, HCJ, HCK, HCL, IAJ, IAK, IAL, IBJ, IBK, IBL, ICJ, ICK, and ICL. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 913 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served the northern half of Kansas. 913 was split in 1997 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 785. It was the 1st area code in the state of Kansas. Kansas currently has 4 area codes.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 913 area code is 1 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 913 never served the entire state of Kansas.

**Pulses:** Because area code 913 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 913 area code requires 9 + 1 + 3 = 13 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 913 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 913 was prioritized more than other area codes created about the same time. The 469 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3

**7 digit dialing:** Before area code overlays were made common in the 1990s, a local phone number could be dialed without dialing the area code – just dialing the last 7 digits of the phone number. Without overlays, it was clear that a 7 digit number should be routed to the local area code. However, with overlays, multiple area codes can serve a single area which makes the area code for a 7 digit number ambiguous. Of the 469 area codes currently active, area code 913 is one of fewer than 71 that still allow 7 digit dialing for local calls. At minimum, to support 7 digit dialing, an area code must not have an overlay and must not allocate numbers of the form 988-XXXX to avoid ambiguity with the 988 suicide prevention lifeline implemented in 2022-2023.

## **Where is area code 430 ?**

Area code 430 is located in northeastern Texas and covers Tyler, Longview, and Sherman. It is an overlay for area code 903 and serves the same area.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 430 was put into service on February 15, 2003 and was the 321st area code in service. It was one of 3 area codes introduced in 2003. It was the 22nd area code in the state of Texas. Texas currently has 28 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 903 area code as the numbers in 903 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 430 is an overlay area code for area code 903.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 432 was put into service on April 5, 2003 and was the 322nd area code in service. It was one of 3 area codes introduced in 2003. It was the 23rd area code in the state of Texas. Texas currently has 28 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 915 area code as the numbers in 915 were being exhausted.

**7 digit dialing:** Before area code overlays were made common in the 1990s, a local phone number could be dialed without dialing the area code – just dialing the last 7 digits of the phone number. Without overlays, it was clear that a 7 digit number should be routed to the local area code. However, with overlays, multiple area codes can serve a single area which makes the area code for a 7 digit number ambiguous. Of the 469 area codes currently active, area code 432 is one of fewer than 71 that still allow 7 digit dialing for local calls. At minimum, to support 7 digit dialing, an area code must not have an overlay and must not allocate numbers of the form 988-XXXX to avoid ambiguity with the 988 suicide prevention lifeline implemented in 2022-2023.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 432 include GDA, GDB, GDC, GEA, GEB, GEC, GFA, GFB, GFC, HDA, HDB, HDC, HEA, HEB, HEC, HFA, HFB, HFC, IDA, IDB, IDC, IEA, IEB, IEC, IFA, IFB, and IFC. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 434 was put into service on June 1, 2001 and was the 298th area code in service. It was one of 26 area codes introduced in 2001. It was the 6th area code in the state of Virginia. Virginia currently has 10 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 804 area code as the numbers in 804 were being exhausted.

**7 digit dialing:** Before area code overlays were made common in the 1990s, a local phone number could be dialed without dialing the area code – just dialing the last 7 digits of the phone number. Without overlays, it was clear that a 7 digit number should be routed to the local area code. However, with overlays, multiple area codes can serve a single area which makes the area code for a 7 digit number ambiguous. Of the 469 area codes currently active, area code 434 is one of fewer than 71 that still allow 7 digit dialing for local calls. At minimum, to support 7 digit dialing, an area code must not have an overlay and must not allocate numbers of the form 988-XXXX to avoid ambiguity with the 988 suicide prevention lifeline implemented in 2022-2023

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 434 include GDG, GDH, GDI, GEG, GEH, GEI, GFG, GFH, GFI, HDG, HDH, HDI, HEG, HEH, HEI, HFG, HFH, HFI, IDG, IDH, IDI, IEG, IEH, IEI, IFG, IFH, and IFI. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 423 was put into service on September 11, 1995 and was the 158th area code in service. It was one of 14 area codes introduced in 1995. 423 was split in 1999 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 865. It was the 3rd area code in the state of Tennessee. Tennessee currently has 7 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 615 area code as the numbers in 615 were being exhausted.

**New/recent overlays:** Though future plans may change, area code 729 has been proposed as a possible overlay for area code 423. The new overlay is expected to go in service on March 5, 2025.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. When the 423 area code was created in 1995, it was the 9th area code without 0 or 1 as the middle digit.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 423 is an overlay area code for area code 615.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 423 include GAD, GAE, GAF, GBD, GBE, GBF, GCD, GCE, GCF, HAD, HAE, HAF, HBD, HBE, HBF, HCD, HCE, HCF, IAD, IAE, IAF, IBD, IBE, IBF, ICD, ICE, and ICF. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 417 was put into service in 1950 and was the 88th area code in service. It was the only area code introduced in 1950. It was the 3rd area code in the state of Missouri. Missouri currently has 9 area codes.

**New/recent overlays:** Area code 557 was recently added as on overaly to the 417 area code on August 12, 2022.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 417 area code is 1 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 417 never served the entire state of Missouri.

**Pulses:** Because area code 417 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 417 area code requires 4 + 1 + 7 = 12 pulses to dial. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 414 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served southern and northeastern Wisconsin including Milwaukee. 414 was split in 1997 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 920, and again in 1999 to create area code 262. It was the 1st area code in the state of Wisconsin. Wisconsin currently has 8 area codes.

**Middle digit:** Area code 414 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served southern and northeastern Wisconsin including Milwaukee. 414 was split in 1997 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 920, and again in 1999 to create area code 262. It was the 1st area code in the state of Wisconsin. Wisconsin currently has 8 area codes.

**Pulses:** Because area code 414 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 414 area code requires 4 + 1 + 4 = 9 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 414 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 414 was prioritized more than other area codes created about the same time. The 469 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3. Only 22 area codes require fewer pulses than area code 414.

**Creation:** Area code 406 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served the entire state of Montana. It is currently the only area code in the state of Montana. Montana is one of only 11 states that still have only a single area code.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 406 area code is 0 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 406 originally served the entire state of Montana. It is one of only 15 of the original 86 area codes that are still used for an entire state.

**Pulses:** Because area code 406 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 406 area code requires 4 + 10 + 6 = 20 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 406 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 406 was prioritized less than other area codes created about the same time. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 405 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served the entire state of Oklahoma. 405 was split in 1997 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 580. In 2021, area code 572 was created and is currently an overlay to 405. It was the 1st area code in the state of Oklahoma. Oklahoma currently has 5 area codes.

**New/recent overlays:** Area code 572 was recently added as on overaly to the 405 area code on May 24, 2021.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 405 area code is 0 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 405 originally served the entire state of Oklahoma. However, it not longer does.

**Pulses:** Because area code 405 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 405 area code requires 4 + 10 + 5 = 19 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 405 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 405 was prioritized less than other area codes created about the same time. The 469 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3.

## **Where is area code 404?**

Area code 404 serves Atlanta, GA and the surrounding areas. It overlaps coverage areas with area codes 470, 678, and 943.

## **What time zone is area code 404?**

The 404 area code is located in the Eastern timezone. The Eastern time zone is also known as America/New\_York. As of the last time this page was loaded.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 404 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served the entire state of Georgia. 404 was split in 1995 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 770. It was the 1st area code in the state of Georgia. Georgia currently has 10 area codes.

**New/recent overlays:** Area code 943 was recently added as on overaly to the 404 area code on March 15, 2022.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 404 area code is 0 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 404 originally served the entire state of Georgia. However, it not longer does.

**Pulses:** Because area code 404 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 404 area code requires 4 + 10 + 4 = 18 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 404 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 404 was prioritized less than other area codes created about the same time. The 469 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 386 was put into service on February 15, 2001 and was the 289th area code in service. It was one of 26 area codes introduced in 2001. It was the 14th area code in the state of Florida. Florida currently has 23 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 904 area code as the numbers in 904 were being exhausted.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. When the 386 area code was created in 2001, it was the 140th area code without 0 or 1 as the middle digit.

**7 digit dialing:** Before area code overlays were made common in the 1990s, a local phone number could be dialed without dialing the area code – just dialing the last 7 digits of the phone number. Without overlays, it was clear that a 7 digit number should be routed to the local area code. However, with overlays, multiple area codes can serve a single area which makes the area code for a 7 digit number ambiguous. Of the 469 area codes currently active, area code 386 is one of fewer than 71 that still allow 7 digit dialing for local calls. At minimum, to support 7 digit dialing, an area code must not have an overlay and must not allocate numbers of the form 988-XXXX to avoid ambiguity with the 988 suicide prevention lifeline implemented in 2022-2023.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. An easy way to remember area code 386, is that 386 dialed on a phone is the same as FUN and FUN is known to occur on Florida beaches. All possible mnemonics for area code 386 include DTM, DTN, DTO, DUM, DUN, DUO, DVM, DVN, DVO, ETM, ETN, ETO, EUM, EUN, EUO, EVM, EVN, EVO, FTM, FTN, FTO, FUM, FUN, FUO, FVM, FVN, and FVO. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 401 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served the entire state of Rhode Island. It is currently the only area code in the state of Rhode Island. Rhode Island is one of only 11 states that still have only a single area code.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 401 area code is 0 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 401 originally served the entire state of Rhode Island. It is one of only 15 of the original 86 area codes that are still used for an entire state.

**Pulses:** Because area code 401 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 401 area code requires 4 + 10 + 1 = 15 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 401 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 401 was prioritized less than other area codes created about the same time. The 469 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3.

**7 digit dialing:** Before area code overlays were made common in the 1990s, a local phone number could be dialed without dialing the area code – just dialing the last 7 digits of the phone number. Without overlays, it was clear that a 7 digit number should be routed to the local area code. However, with overlays, multiple area codes can serve a single area which makes the area code for a 7 digit number ambiguous. Of the 469 area codes currently active, area code 401 is one of fewer than 71 that still allow 7 digit dialing for local calls. At minimum, to support 7 digit dialing, an area code must not have an overlay and must not allocate numbers of the form 988-XXXX to avoid ambiguity with the 988 suicide prevention lifeline implemented in 2022-2023.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 385 was put into service on March 29, 2009 and was the 339th area code in service. It was one of 8 area codes introduced in 2009. It was the 3rd area code in the state of Utah. Utah currently has 3 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 801 area code as the numbers in 801 were being exhausted.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. When the 385 area code was created in 2009, it was the 190th area code without 0 or 1 as the middle digit.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 385 is an overlay area code for area code 801.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 385 include DTJ, DTK, DTL, DUJ, DUK, DUL, DVJ, DVK, DVL, ETJ, ETK, ETL, EUJ, EUK, EUL, EVJ, EVK, EVL, FTJ, FTK, FTL, FUJ, FUK, FUL, FVJ, FVK, and FVL. ## **Where is area code 380 ?**

Area code 380 serves Columbus, OH and the surrounding areas. It is an overlay for area code 614 and serves the same area.

## **What time zone is area code 380 ?**

The 380 area code is located in the Eastern timezone. The Eastern time zone is also known as America/New\_York. As of the last time this page was loaded.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 380 was put into service on February 27, 2016 and was the 386th area code in service. It was one of 7 area codes introduced in 2016. It was the 12th area code in the state of Ohio. Ohio currently has 15 area codes. It was created to relieve the pressure on the 614 area code as the numbers in 614 were being exhausted.

**Overlay:** Prior to 1992, each area code served a geographic area and that geographic area had only a single area code. If the phone numbers available for an area code were nearly exhausted, the existing area code and geographic area would be split. However, the North American Number Plan Administrator (NANPA) started to create overlay area codes in 1992 – area codes that would serve the same geographic area. Area code 380 is an overlay area code for area code 614.

## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 413 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served western Massachusetts including Springfield. It was the 1st area code in the state of Massachusetts. Massachusetts currently has 9 area codes.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 413 area code is 1 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 413 never served the entire state of Massachusetts.

**Pulses:** Because area code 413 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 413 area code requires 4 + 1 + 3 = 8 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 413 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 413 was prioritized more than other area codes created about the same time. The 469 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3. Only 10 area codes require fewer pulses (212, 213, 312, 231, 321, 214, 313, 412, 331, and 223) than area code 413.

**7 digit dialing:** Before area code overlays were made common in the 1990s, a local phone number could be dialed without dialing the area code – just dialing the last 7 digits of the phone number. Without overlays, it was clear that a 7 digit number should be routed to the local area code. However, with overlays, multiple area codes can serve a single area which makes the area code for a 7 digit number ambiguous. Of the 469 area codes currently active, area code 413 is one of fewer than 71 that still allow 7 digit dialing for local calls. At minimum, to support 7 digit dialing, an area code must not have an overlay and must not allocate numbers of the form 988-XXXX to avoid ambiguity with the 988 suicide prevention lifeline implemented in 2022-2023.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state/province while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state/province. When the 242 area code was created in 1996, it was the 31st area code without 0 or 1 as the middle digit.

**7 digit dialing:** Before area code overlays were made common in the 1990s, a local phone number could be dialed without dialing the area code – just dialing the last 7 digits of the phone number. Without overlays, it was clear that a 7 digit number should be routed to the local area code. However, with overlays, multiple area codes can serve a single area which makes the area code for a 7 digit number ambiguous. Of the 467 area codes currently active, area code 242 is one of fewer than 71 that still allow 7 digit dialing for local calls. At minimum, to support 7 digit dialing, an area code must not have an overlay and must not allocate numbers of the form 988-XXXX to avoid ambiguity with the 988 suicide prevention lifeline implemented in 2022-2023.

**Mnemonics:** Prior to 1995, the middle digit of area codes was restricted to a 0 or 1 which do not correspond to a letter on a phone’s dialing pad. So, only area codes created in 1995 or later can have a mnemonic. The mnemonics for area code 242 include AGA, AGB, AGC, AHA, AHB, AHC, AIA, AIB, AIC, BGA, BGB, BGC, BHA, BHB, BHC, BIA, BIB, BIC, CGA, CGB, CGC, CHA, CHB, CHC, CIA, CIB, and CIC. ## **History**

**Creation:** Area code 517 was put into service in 1947 and was one of the original 86 area codes, and it originally served south-central portion of the lower peninsula of Michigan including Lansing. 517 was split in 2001 creating the need to update some of the phone numbers to area code 989. It was the 1st area code in the state of Michigan. Michigan currently has 12 area codes.

**Middle digit:** Until 1953, the middle digit was restricted to either a 0 or a 1 where a zero indicated that the area code covered the entire state while a 1 indicated that the area code served only a portion of a state. Because the middle digit of the 517 area code is 1 and it was created prior to 1953, we can tell area code 517 never served the entire state of Michigan.

**Pulses:** Because area code 517 was created before the 1960s when touch tone dialing became more common, the number of pulses required on a rotary phone was still important. Area codes that required fewer pulses were faster to dial and were commonly prioritized for more populated areas. The 517 area code requires 5 + 1 + 7 = 13 pulses to dial. The 90 area codes created in the 5 years prior or the 5 years after area code 517 averaged 14.1 pulses indicating 517 was prioritized more than other area codes created about the same time. The 469 currently active area codes require pulses that range from 5 to 29 and average 16.3.

**7 digit dialing:** Before area code overlays were made common in the 1990s, a local phone number could be dialed without dialing the area code – just dialing the last 7 digits of the phone number. Without overlays, it was clear that a 7 digit number should be routed to the local area code. However, with overlays, multiple area codes can serve a single area which makes the area code for a 7 digit number ambiguous. Of the 469 area codes currently active, area code 517 is one of fewer than 71 that still allow 7 digit dialing for local calls. At minimum, to support 7 digit dialing, an area code must not have an overlay and must not allocate numbers of the form 988-XXXX to avoid ambiguity with the 988 suicide prevention lifeline implemented in 2022-2023.
